cause.boundary: Windows physical input to semantic terminal key
details: ReadConsoleInputW decoding treated Unicode control values as literal text before deriving Ctrl+A..Z identity
Win32 CSI record decoding trusted the layout-dependent virtual key over Unicode C0 control identity
non-Kitty key releases could be encoded as duplicate modifyOtherKeys presses

requiredInvariant: A physical control key retains one semantic identity through host decoding, protocol transport, and child-mode encoding; U+0001 through U+001A authoritatively identify Ctrl+A through Ctrl+Z regardless of virtual-key metadata.
mandatoryCoverage: all Ctrl+A through Ctrl+Z Win32 records
legacy, modifyOtherKeys, Kitty, and Win32 child encodings
key-release suppression outside protocols that report release
packaged real-Pi Ctrl+C flow must not produce the Ctrl+P model-cycle status
